title: Book Two · Chapter 50: The Next Helpers
story:
On Monday, two new helpers stand at the book desk. Mei is at her own seat with a drawing book. Ronan stops beside her.

“Your pencil is not there today.”

“I need this one for my picture,” she says. She holds it above the page.

Ronan looks toward the card box. The new helpers open it and read the first few names. Miss Wu stands beside them for the start.

Ronan's shelf turn is over, too. But the train book is still flat in its low space. His small label stands beside it.

A new helper points to the arrow.

“Is this for the big book?”

“Yes.”

“Can you show me?”

Ronan goes over. He takes the book out and points to the repaired page. The helper puts it back below the other large cover.

“Like that?”

“Yes. Keep the label clear.”

Miss Wu asks Ronan to show the two desk marks next. He points to the left side.

“Returned books here. They still need the card check.”

“And this side?” the other helper asks.

“The checked ones. Then they can go back.”

The shared pencil is beside the card box. Ronan leaves it for the new helpers.

Jun comes with a book for the next lesson. Miss Wu needs the station picture again. She asks the boys to put it on the front table.

Jun gives Ronan the book.

They carry it flat between them. The small repaired edge stays clear of their fingers. They put it down and open to the picture.

“Here,” Jun says.

Ronan nods. Then he goes back to his own desk. Jun sits behind him and opens his school book.

Miss Wu begins the lesson with a few simple questions. Ronan answers one. On the next, he looks back at the page before he lifts his hand.

Later, she talks about their reading practice.

“We will try another short page soon,” she says. “Each of you can read it alone. Then we can look at your answers together.”

“Another kite story?” Leo asks.

“A different story.”

“Do we get places this time?” Ronan asks.

Miss Wu shakes her head. “It is practice. We are not choosing a winner.”

Ronan looks at his exercise book. His name is on the cover. He still wants to do better than the others. He also wants the next answer to be right.

He opens to a clean page. He writes practice at the top, then waits. Miss Wu gives them their number work instead. The new story has no date yet.

At break, Leo takes out a folded paper from Saturday's reading room. It has a new picture on the front.

“Another page?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. There are two inside.”

Ronan wants one for himself. He looks at the folded edges. Leo opens the first part and points to a short line.

“Can we look at this after lunch?” he asks. “I want to read it again.”

“Yes,” Ronan says.

Jun comes to the door with the cloth ball. Ronan puts his exercise book away. Leo keeps the folded page in his own bag.

They go outside together. The ball drops near the first step. Ronan picks it up and looks ahead. There is room to play. He throws the ball to Jun.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

helper＝帮手；label＝标签；practice＝练习；shelf＝架子。

## 理解问题

1. 新的帮手怎样接手借阅角？
2. Ronan对后续练习有什么愿望，哪些事还没决定？

## 读句子

**Jun / gives / Ronan the book.** Jun／把书／递给Ronan。
